manifest.name: gdn-q4k-deep
manifest.description: Q4_K on the recurrent projections of the deeper half only (layers 32-63). V4 puts all 144 GDN projections in Q4_K and clears the holdout; if the shallow half is where the recurrent state is most sensitive, half the map should keep most of the memory saving at less drift.

execution.packed_wide: NVFP4 if free VRAM at load > payload + 3 GiB, else Q4_K(nvfp4)
